featured_reviews.name: Madhavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Remedy Church in Kandivali West is a peaceful and welcoming place that holds deep spiritual significance for the local community. The church has a calm and prayerful atmosphere, making it an ideal space for reflection, worship, and inner peace, even amidst the busy surroundings of the city.

The church is well maintained and aesthetically pleasing, with a simple yet beautiful interior that helps devotees focus on prayer. The Masses are well organized, meaningful, and conducted with devotion, making them spiritually uplifting for people of all ages. The choir and liturgy add to the reverent experience, especially during feast days and special occasions.

One of the most admirable aspects of Our Lady of Remedy Church is its strong sense of community. The parish actively engages in social, educational, and charitable activities, encouraging unity and service among parishioners. The clergy and volunteers are approachable, supportive, and dedicated to guiding the faithful.

Overall, Our Lady of Remedy Church is not just a place of worship but a spiritual home for many. It stands as a symbol of faith, hope, and togetherness in Kandivali West, and is highly recommended for anyone seeking a serene and spiritually enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sania Serrao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Remedy Church in Borivali is not just a place of worship, but a space filled with peace, faith, and a strong sense of community. The church stands beautifully with its serene surroundings, offering a calm escape from the busy pace of city life.

As you step inside, there’s an immediate feeling of quiet reflection and comfort. The interiors are simple yet graceful, creating a spiritual atmosphere that invites prayer and contemplation. Regular masses, novenas, and festive celebrations bring the parish community together, especially during important occasions like Christmas and the annual feast.

What makes this church truly special is the warmth of the people and the welcoming environment. Whether you visit for prayer, a special ceremony, or simply to find a moment of peace, Our Lady of Remedy Church leaves you feeling spiritually uplifted and connected.

featured_reviews.name: Mahima Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
City Rock Church Mumbai is incredible. The fellowship here reflects pure, unconditional love among Gen Z and youth churchmates. The worship is refreshing, and you can truly feel God's presence.
This English church community is located near me, and they feel like one big, loving family. The sermons are always relevant and speak directly to the needs of a youth church. Pastor Shailesh, Pastor Aishwariya, and leaders like Anugrah Dada have all been a huge inspiration.
Everyone deserves to experience a community like this—it’s life-changing. This church in Mumbai has drawn me closer to God and made my walk with Christ more joyful.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text: City Rock Church in Mumbai impressed me with its warm and inviting atmosphere during my first Sunday church service there. Vibrant worship and empowering sermons positively influenced my spiritual journey, fostering a sense of belonging among hospitable Gen Z and youth church mates. Dedicated ministries and leaders provide mentorship, support, and fellowship. Additionally, it is conveniently located as an English church near me. I highly recommend it for its relevant teaching and strong sense of church community.

featured_reviews.name: Phukhato Sema
featured_reviews.review_text: Coming from Assam (North East) I was looking for a Church in Mumbai on internet where they preach the Biblical doctrine and I landed in CRC, Mumbai. I was rest assured that I don’t have to find another Church!  If you are a youth and searching for a Church, well without any second thought visit City Rock Church, you won’t regret! It has an energetic and enthusiastic vibe. Friendly people, amazing hospitality and not to forget the spirit filled Praise & Worship followed by the word of God by amazing pastors.

featured_reviews.name: Sandesh Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text: God has changed my life amazingly ever since I've started going to City Rock Church Mumbai. I've learnt so many things about Christ through my leaders. The parts of the service are taken care of nicely. It makes me feel like I'm home. This community has helped me to discover the purpose of my life!

featured_reviews.name: Amruta Dhiwar
featured_reviews.review_text: The church is the place where we come together to encourage one another as member's of Christ's body. Together we fulfill an important purpose on the Earth. I highly recommend this church if you are in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A Roman Catholic Church located in Borivli. Built in 1993 by the Salesians of Don Bosco, this church is dedicated to St. John Bosco. Its interior is spacious having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, ceiling fans, chandelier etc. The facade of this church is modern having a wall sculpture of Don Bosco along with young children. There is a grotto within the church premises. Also, there is a school attached to the church. Had attended a mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.

featured_reviews.name: Viveca Dourado
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a catholic, it’s with a heavy heart I write this. Regret having my wedding nuptials at St. John Bosco parish, Borivali. In the name of ‘nuptial fees/donation’ whatever they call it, we were exploited and charged 7 times more than the usual amount, and neighbouring parishes in other areas charge nothing close to that. This ‘fee’ did not include anything and additionally we were expected to give extra ‘fees’ to their Sacristy and Digital team. Deeply disappointed for a Catholic Church. Strongly encourage couples to sought other parishes for their Nuptials.

featured_reviews.name: Sameer Allahrakhia
featured_reviews.review_text: Had been for my friends daughters Christening . It’s a beautiful church bringing back memories of my time in a convent school.  Even though there was ample space in the premises the watchman did not allow us to park the car inside the compound. This is one feedback for the church management to be considerate and allow parking as there’s a no parking zone. Thanks

featured_reviews.name: Drawin_D_ Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Located in the heart of Orlem our lady of Lourdes, Church in the archdiocese of Mumbai is an active and enthusiastic Parish. With great priests, good community contribution and support and a wonderful Choir.

featured_reviews.name: jojo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feeling of peace and happiness in divine environment as renewed interiors, exteriors  after prefabrication
and  rededicated to the  parish. The repairing work of interior walls, false ceilings and hanging chandelier giving new look and being blessed.

featured_reviews.name: Sherald Gomes
featured_reviews.review_text: Holy place of worship where when alone feels serenity and peaceful and within my vicinity any time can go and pray either in the church or visit the blessed sacrament.

featured_reviews.name: Jolenta Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: A beautiful vibrant church in the heart of Orlem, Malad West. What's truly amazing about this place is that you will also see cats peacefully snoozing and not a soul troubling them, which is commendable. Irrespective of who you are, this church welcomes all humans, felines and doggos alike and does not discriminate, unlike other places of worship where animals (even humans) are shooed. Don't be surprised if you see a doggo in the church passing by the altar during the eucharistic celebration. It's truly warms your heart.

featured_reviews.name: Sweet Pie
featured_reviews.review_text: Peaceful church..I like hear the masses as the sermons are short and beautiful.The recent church decor is so bright and peaceful.Another thing I like is the annocement made are short not making people bored.Although i stay in Kandivali but i come here to attend the service

featured_reviews.name: Neil Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text: The place that gives Orlem it's very identity, a landmark in Malad, my refuge for peace, the Church has seen many changes and renovations but it's soul stays the same, a wonderful experience to visit this Church specially during Christmas and Easter.

featured_reviews.name: snap zep
featured_reviews.review_text:
Small church very closely knit together with approximately 500 families. Located at Kandivali east, Mumbai.
Sunday mass timings are morning 7.30am and 9.00am. Very sweet people here!

featured_reviews.name: Noel Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text: A small yet vibrant parish, blessed with a prayerful community, a beautiful choir, and devoted service. The peaceful atmosphere draws hearts closer to God, making it a place of prayer, worship, and spiritual renewal. Guided by faith and growing in grace, it continues to flourish as one of the most inspiring parishes in the suburbs.

featured_reviews.name: Civin Vincent
featured_reviews.review_text: Small parish with very good choir and service. They have weekday evening Mass at 6:30pm IST. The Sunday mass is only scheduled in the morning which occurs at 7:30am IST.

featured_reviews.name: Shonel Hendricks Teke
featured_reviews.review_text: A wonderful little Church building with a rustic ambience, homely environment and warm vibes  between all in the community.

featured_reviews.name: Bosco D'Gama
featured_reviews.review_text: Quiet, calm and reserved ambience. Cleanliness is msintained as also hand sanitizing and social distancing.

featured_reviews.name: Roney Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: Only church for residents in around 4km radius. Small but well taken care with parking availability

featured_reviews.name: Felix Ferns
featured_reviews.review_text:
All parishioners gets-together as1 community. Thanks to Fr.Raphael for all his efforts and motivation.
God Bless NOLC.

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv Sundararaju
featured_reviews.review_text: Small Catholic Church, social distancing maintained during mass. Peaceful atmosphere

featured_reviews.name: Bosco Abreo
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a place of Prayers and worship. Every Sunday we have the English Mass at 9.00 am in the Infant Jesus Chapel. Apart from some exceptions during feast time. It's a very comfortable place and it also has a blessed sacrament attached to it.

featured_reviews.name: Earl Alemao
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited the chapel and was captivated by its serene appearance. The spiritual atmosphere is truly uplifting. A tranquil haven for reflection and connection. Grateful for this sacred space.

featured_reviews.name: Youth India
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most famous church you must visit. They welcome people from all religion.

The management is good. If you are alone and have time go there you will find peace here in infant Jesus chapel.

featured_reviews.name: Pury Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a Chapel not a church. Because of space 80% end up sitting outside. With the traffic sound people are distracted and half the prayer cannot be heard.  Don't know if God is pleased at the end of the service or are Christians just performing their duty by participating in a ritual...

featured_reviews.name: Francis D Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very very old chapel known for its devotion celebration of Infant Jesus Feast.
Though the chapel has undergone renovation, the traditions are still followed and kept.
Cosy little place to enjoy serenity

featured_reviews.name: Christina D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: It's quite a big catholic Chapel which is affiliated to St. Anthony's church located on Marve Road, Malad west. It's good for people residing in the vicinity and is also easily accessible.

featured_reviews.name: abigail d'mello
featured_reviews.review_text:
One should visit this Shrine,  it's a replica of Nasik Shrine.
Infant JESUS Bless and Grant the petitions of all.
Thank you Jesus.

featured_reviews.name: Claro Menezes
featured_reviews.review_text: Holy Mass timings: at 7:00 am on every Monday, Wednesday & Friday. Sunday mass in Marathi at 7:00 am, English at 9:00 am and evening at 6:30 pm.
